entries.9dc403ceb086deec: This business operates “Yoshinoya” fast-food outlets in Japan, selling gyudon and other dishes, and provides management guidance to franchised outlets. The principal company is Yoshinoya Co., Ltd., and the company is carrying out an organizational restructuring to merge six domestic Yoshinoya operating companies into one company, Yoshinoya Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥150,190 million (up 9.8% year on year), the largest of the reportable segments. Segment profit (based on operating profit) was ¥7,623 million (down 2.1% year on year), affected by cost increases, mainly for raw materials. The number of stores at the end of the period was 1,290; during the period, 51 stores opened and 20 closed. Stores with the new service models (Cooking & Comfort and Jigsaw Counter) increased by 50 to 590, and 897 stores had tablets installed; the company plans to introduce tablets in all stores during fiscal 2026.

The core of income is sales at stores, and it also obtains royalties from franchise stores as consideration for trademarks and operating know-how. Net sales for the fiscal year ended February 2026 were ¥225,667 million, of which the Yoshinoya [[term:segment|segment]] accounts for the largest proportion.
entries.afa02f92da1378f4: This is the business that operates fast-food restaurants such as beef bowl restaurants in the United States, China, the ASEAN region and elsewhere, and provides management guidance to franchise stores and others. Because it carries out multiple business activities by region and by base, they are grouped into 1 segment called "Overseas." The main companies are YOSHINOYA AMERICA,INC. (United States), Yoshinoya (China) Investment Co., Ltd. (China) and ASIA YOSHINOYA INTERNATIONAL SDN.BHD. (Malaysia). Net sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended February 2026 were ¥29,323 million (up 5.2% from the same period of the previous year), and segment profit was ¥1,957 million (up 61.2%). The number of stores at the end of the period was 1,035; 111 stores were opened and 74 stores were closed during the period. In Singapore, a central kitchen that obtained halal certification in June 2025 began operating, and it slices beef in-house, which leads to stable quality. Because overseas operations use a calendar-year closing, results from January to December are included in this period.
entries.afcea5f1d2ffea02: Yoshinoya operates fast-food stores serving beef bowls and other items in Japan, Hanamaru operates fast-food stores serving self-service Sanuki udon and other items, and overseas it operates stores serving beef bowls and other items in the United States, China, the ASEAN region and other areas. The number of group stores as of the end of the fiscal year ended February 2026 was 2,886 (Yoshinoya 1,290 stores, Hanamaru 418 stores, Overseas 1,035 stores; the remainder are stores in the Other category and others, and the annual securities report does not give a breakdown). entries.e47308a1375c4627: This business operates self-service Sanuki udon and other fast-food outlets under the “Hanamaru” name in Japan, and provides management guidance to franchised outlets. The principal company is Hanamaru Co., Ltd. (Takamatsu City, Kagawa Prefecture). In the fiscal year ended February 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥32,795 million (up 6.9% year on year) and segment profit was ¥2,427 million (up 21.0% year on year). The number of stores at the end of the period was 418; during the period, 16 stores opened and 13 closed. To advance dominant store openings (concentrating store openings in a specific area) in major metropolitan areas, it opened “Zuzuzu,” a new format compact model store of 20 tsubo, in Nihonbashi, Tokyo, in October 2025. In addition, under the “Oidemai! Sanuki Project,” launched on the occasion of the 25th anniversary of its founding, the noodles at 14 stores in Kagawa Prefecture were switched to noodles made from the Kagawa-grown wheat “Sanuki no Yume.”
entries.e4d0d71aef8acbc7: Operating profit for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥8,089 million (up 10.7% year on year), ordinary profit was ¥8,803 million, and net profit attributable to owners of parent was ¥4,665 million.
